patterns.note: Sections alternate between dark (black) and light (white) backgrounds, creating strong visual breaks and emphasizing content within each section.
A monospaced font is used for subtle labels, metadata, and code-like elements, contrasting with the bold sans-serif headings and body text.
A primary color palette of bright blue, yellow, and red is used as strong accents against a high-contrast black and white base, often appearing as horizontal bars or text highlights.
The hero section features a large, abstract molecular graphic and colored bars that parallax, moving slower than the foreground text as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
A subtle grid pattern is visible in the background of some white sections, providing a structured yet open feel.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a parallax effect where a background graphic and colored elements scroll at a different rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth. This effect, along with scroll-triggered section reveals (fade-in and slide-up), is likely orchestrated using a JavaScript animation library like GSAP ScrollTrigger, animating elements as they enter or exit the viewport.

Interactive background elements, such as the pixelated molecular structure and dynamic colored bars, are integrated into the design, likely using Lottie animations or video-hero elements, to add visual interest and reinforce the scientific theme.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) are paired with legible body text and small, often uppercase monospaced labels for details.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, with open horizontal spacing in multi-column layouts.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, high-contrast aesthetic, combining abstract scientific graphics with a vibrant primary color palette and a monospaced typeface. This creates a unique retro-futuristic, high-tech feel that is both authoritative and visually engaging, moving beyond typical corporate biotech sites.
